_comment: TEMPLATE for cvb-guard.config.json — the CVB (Claude Von Braun) PreToolUse bouncer. setup.mjs renders this by replacing the {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens with your real paths (lowercase, forward slashes) and writing cvb-guard.config.json next to it. CVB may write COORDINATION artifacts, never DELIVERABLES, and never GOVERNANCE files. Tune behavior by editing the rendered file; no code changes needed. All path checks are case-insensitive and forward-slash-normalized.
_writeAllow: Paths CVB MAY Edit/Write. prefixes = startsWith; contains = substring; exact = full match.
_writeAllowRegex: Case-insensitive regex allow-patterns (matched against the normalized path). Covers CVB's own memory under any per-scope .claude/projects/<scope>/memory/ dir (his memory path varies by which chat he's in).
_writeDeny: Governance files CVB may NEVER write, even if an allow rule would match. Changing personas or team rules needs the owner's go-ahead. basenames = exact filename; contains = substring (protects vault/team canon).
_bashDeny: Bash is default-ALLOW. Ordinary git writes (add/commit/merge/checkout/plain push), builds, pm2, and deploy scripts are ALLOWED — CVB runs commits and deployments for reviewed work. Still DENIED: git history surgery (rebase/reset/clean/cherry-pick/am/apply), force or delete pushes, amended commits, package publishing, image-gen python, and raw file mutation (rm/mv/cp). firstToken = the executable name of any command segment; regex = matched against each quote-stripped segment (case-insensitive).
